dataset: UW-IS Occluded, Figshare 20506506 v1, CC BY 4.0
reference_selection: Three largest visible annotation-mask areas in each fixed reference frame, bounding rectangle with four-pixel margin clipped to the image. Selected before predictions.
cases: Six same-category paired-view cases and six cyclic cross-category negatives (kitchen references to food views, food to tools, tools to kitchen). Original reference photographs and observation photographs are distinct.
truth: Original pose-name/mask-ID records and visible mask pixels, with all selected RGB images visually inspected before inference. Missing targets are absent from these supplied pictures, not a claimed physical inventory absence.
oracle_separation: Inference receives only unmodified RGB bytes, reference rectangles and ordered view names. Observation masks, poses, target positions and answer annotations are withheld.
localization: For machine-supported suggested polygons, bbox IoU against the target's visible-mask rectangle in that view. IoU >= 0.30 is a deliberately loose diagnostic localization screen, not full-object identity. Appearance-only proposals are excluded from this support measure.
scope: Small external-source photographic diagnostic. Shared objects, background and clip frames mean cases are not independent trials. One lounge and lighting condition; largest reference objects only. No representative accuracy, physical count, full kit completeness, human trial or AWS execution claim.
